raise-error.description: the admin MCP server is disabled: set admin.key

mcp:tool-listener.name: add_document
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Adds a document to the knowledge base that the agent's search_docs tool searches. The text is split into passages (docs.chunkSize characters), embedded and stored. A document with the same id is replaced. Returns {id, chunks, replaced}.
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","description":"The document's text (plain text or Markdown)."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"Document id: 1 to 128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -. Give the same id to replace a document. Leave it out to get a new id."},"source":{"type":"string","description":"Where the document came from (for example faq or a URL). Search results carry it."}},"required":["text"]}

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- {id: payload.id default uuid(), text: payload.text default '', source: payload.source default 'mcp'}]

mcp:tool-listener.name: delete_document
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Deletes a document and its passages from the knowledge base. Returns {id, deleted} (deleted is false when there was no such document).

validation:matches-regex.message: id must be 1 to 128 letters, digits, '_', '.', ':' or '-'

mcp:tool-listener.name: list_documents
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists the documents in the knowledge base, sorted by id: [{id, source, chars, chunks, added, model}] (model is the embedding model the passages were made with).

set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- (valuesOf(payload) map {id: $.id, source: $.source, chars: $.chars, chunks: $.chunks, added: $.added, model: $.model}) orderBy $.id]

mcp:tool-listener.name: search_documents
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Searches the knowledge base the same way the agent's search_docs tool does, and shows the scores: [{score, id, source, text}], closest first. Only passages scoring at least docs.minScore are returned.
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"What to look for."},"maxResults":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":50,"description":"How many passages to return at most (default docs.maxResults)."}},"required":["query"]}

set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- (payload.sources default []) map {score: $.score, id: $.metadata.docId, source: $.metadata.source, text: $.text}]

mcp:tool-listener.name: reindex_documents
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Embeds and stores every document again from its saved text, with the current embedding model (embed.model). Use it after changing the embedding model, or when the passage store was lost (for example after a redeploy). Returns {reindexed, model}.

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- {id: payload.id, text: payload.text, source: payload.source, added: payload.added}]
